learning_outcomes.text: Students can derive 3-view projections from spatial objects.
Students can find and work with current standards, especially concerning ISO GPS.
Students can create technical single-part and assembly drawings by hand and with CAD, applying current standards.
Students can identify and interpret representations according to outdated standards in technical drawings.
Students can identify gear elements in complex assembly drawings.
Students can make sensible use of literature on technical drawing in combination with current standards.
They conceive single-part drawings with the aim of ensuring functionality, manufacturability, and assembly suitability.
They conceive assembly drawings for the integration of functionally suitable machine elements.

syllabus_topics: Representation of complete constructions in assembly drawings
Representation of workpieces in single-part drawings
Fundamentals of component and assembly modeling with CAD
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination and proof of performance. The grading of the module contributes to the final grade as per the study and examination regulations (SPO).
